name: fixora-properties
description: Fixora Properties - direct property marketplace for buyers and sellers, with a platform-fee pricing model

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=packages/types && npm run build --workspace=packages/validation && npm run build --workspace=apps/api && npm run build --workspace=apps/web
scripts.build:api: npm run build --workspace=packages/types && npm run build --workspace=packages/validation && npm run build --workspace=apps/api
scripts.build:web: npm run build --workspace=packages/types && npm run build --workspace=packages/validation && npm run build --workspace=apps/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace=apps/web && npm run lint --workspace=apps/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace=apps/api && npm run typecheck --workspace=apps/web
